survey: Image 9 shows a DJ controller with headphones, viewed from above at three-quarter angle and resting on an orange surface. The controller is one body in three sections. The left deck sits forward and the right deck sits slightly back. Each deck has a jog wheel, a red display, a grid of colored buttons, a row of four pads and a corner knob. The two decks mirror each other: the left deck's knob is top-left and the right deck's knob is top-right. The centre mixer section joins the decks. It has a raised screen at the back, three knobs and fader slots with caps that sit in their slots. All buttons, pads and knobs are pressable from the top face. The body rests flat on the surface, with a darker base strip and a contact shadow. The jog wheels read as flat discs in perspective: ellipse ratios are 0.59–0.65 with the short axis near vertical, and both wheels match. They are seated in round recesses. The headphones lie flat beside the controller. The headband arcs from the right cup's yoke and slider to the left cup. The left cup faces up with its ear-pad opening showing. The right cup shows its outer shell. Both cups rest on the surface. They are wireless, with no cable, so there are no loose ends. The tool marked no thin-part ends or branches.
